entities.name: Query IspD-IspF protein
observations: 379 aa soluble-looking bacterial protein with predicted N-terminal IspD domain (PF01128, residues 5–214) and C-terminal IspF/YgbB domain (PF02542, residues 223–376).
Closest reviewed homologs are bifunctional IspD/IspF proteins with 63.9–66.4% identity and approximately full-length coverage.
Sequence-based functional evidence supports two activities in the MEP isoprenoid pathway: IspD cytidylyltransferase and IspF cyclodiphosphate synthase.

entities.name: MEP cytidylyltransferase reaction
observations: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate + CTP + H+ → 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol + diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.60; Rhea RHEA:13429.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The two activities correspond to steps 2 and 4 of the non-mevalonate/DXR pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis, ultimately supporting terpenoid biosynthesis.

entities.name: Query protein properties
observations: Length 379 aa; estimated molecular mass 39.83 kDa; theoretical pI 6.20; predicted charge at pH 7 approximately −5.18.
A divalent metal cation is annotated as a cofactor for the homologous bifunctional enzyme.
